QuestInfo.0: With #p2411011#'s weeping fit fading into history, Alpha and Beta decided to return to #b#MDmap321190300##k to explain all the weird things that happened in #m321100000#. The man named #b#p2411010##k would surely have some answers.
QuestInfo.1: #p2400005# and #p2400006# sang a sweet #blullaby#k to console #p2411011# for #p2411010#, but the dragon was an emotional wreck! In the end, they decided that the only thing for the safety of the village was to tranquilize the dragon.  Luckily, #b#p2411001##k in #b#m321100000##k knew of a sleep-inducing instrument.
QuestInfo.2: #p2411001# in #m321100000# knew of the instrument! The duo was on their way to sleepytown.

1.0: Oh hiya! You must be the explorers Chief Tatamo mentioned. I hear you're looking for an instrument to make a big old dragon go to sleep! I'm sooo glad to meet another music lover in this town.

npc.0: There is a Halflinger named Pam with the most impressive musical affinity I've ever seen. She will help, if you ask nicely.
